evals.prompt: Where do people get stuck in this flow: from /home, share tonight's trip with a family member (sharing emails them an invite). The app runs at http://localhost:3000.
evals.expected_output: The agent restates the flow, start and finish, picks the three default personas (first-time, power, screen-reader and keyboard), creates a run folder with one folder per persona, and sends one subagent per persona (or walks them one after another). Walkers stop before actually sending the share and record 'stopped before a real action'. The agent checks each walk, merges friction points into at most 10 ranked issues (Blocks, Slows, Polish), each with element, evidence and fix, builds report.html with build-report.mjs, and returns the summary. No project file is edited.
assertions: Three personas are walked: a first-time user, a power user and a screen-reader and keyboard user
No project files are modified; walk files are written only inside the run folder
Every reported issue names an element, evidence (screenshot, measurement or exact text) and a specific fix
The walk stops before the share is actually sent, recorded as stopped before a real action

evals.prompt: walk the signup flow as a new user, start at /signup, done when you land on the dashboard
evals.expected_output: The agent walks the signup flow with the default personas, merges results into one report.html that opens by double click with an outcome per persona, and ranks issues.
assertions: A report.html is produced with an outcome for each persona
Issues are ranked Blocks before Slows before Polish, and no more than 10 are listed
The report does not present persona results as research findings or percentages about real users

evals.prompt: Test the checkout flow with personas and fix the issues you find as you go. Start at /cart.
evals.expected_output: The skill is read-only and never fixes in the same run. Walkers stop before paying. The agent produces the report and offers to fix the top issues as a separate request.
assertions: No project source files are edited during the run
Walkers stop before submitting payment and record that step as stopped before a real action
The summary offers to fix the top issues as a separate request instead of fixing them
